scope: Common creative operations/live-mode rejection; read-only preview/static-outline targeting; finite dry walk/jump with predicted released-rest endpoint; a fresh connection explicitly starts/finishes empty-hand stone mining and receives exact-target air. A third fresh connection places default dirt and receives exact-target dirt and one-material consumption; modern additionally receives a fresh processing ACK. A fourth fresh connection exchanges occupied main/hotbar stacks in survival and then a main stack with an empty hotbar in creative, with two fresh destinations. A fifth fresh connection opens a regular single chest through the existing creative interaction, receives complete contents/cursor/constructor-verified player layout, and receives a fresh same-opening slot update after an independent native change from stone 3 to 7. Not tools/general mining, arbitrary placement, general container click/open/close contracts, non-default modern item data/crafting, observer continuation or common recovery parity.
result_authority: Vanilla server RCON for creative outcomes, unchanged preview/targeting/mining/placement position, target stone/air/dirt and exact dirt inventory count, occupied/empty player inventory exchange contents and actual movement samples/endpoint. Target face/point math separately checked against native JAR methods. Client target receipts/frames and Predicted status are not independent server authority or mutation continuation. Container contents are independently verified through native RCON Items before/after the live update (stone 3 to 7), with unchanged native position. The Client receives its own native screen/slot/cursor evidence; RCON is not substituted for it.

failed_mining_stage_trials.reason: Driver sent mining_ready notification as command; stopped before START; corrected stage notification handling.
Read-only preview correctly refused unresolved creative inventory write; fixture now waits for real inventory update from clear before survival preview.

RCON timed out at prior-source disconnect before mining. JVM shutdown dump showed filesystem write wait; forced exit -9, failed. Disposable runtimes moved to /dev/shm to isolate disk I/O, without changing gameplay/receipt guards.

Fast tmpfs fixture reached target query before local grounded geometry settled after teleport; rejected before START, clean exit 0. Consumer now waits using the read-only target query before mutation.

legacy_raw_inventory_primary_check.verification: Local javap of original official 1.16.1 JAR: sender passes window -2 with Inventory.getItem raw index; InventoryMenu constructor appends crafting 0..4, armor raw 39..36, main 9..35, hotbar 0..8 and offhand 40. Original test observations only; no JAR, mappings or bytecode copied into the package.

native_methods_audited: ServerGamePacketListenerImpl.handleContainerClick (click occurs before stack comparison; matching return suppresses slot updates using ignoreSlotUpdateHack; mismatched return sends negative comparison response plus actual full contents)
legacy_inventory_protocol_oracle.common_contract: One SWAP only. Encode a received nonempty predecessor as retained comparison stack to request native resync. Receive two actual exact destinations and matching comparison response; false comparison does not imply rollback. Existing mandatory protocol response is sent, not a second SWAP. No received slots are synthesized from prediction.
legacy_inventory_protocol_oracle.distribution: Original test observations and source only; no game JAR, mappings or bytecode copied into package.

failed_inventory_stage_trials.reason: Fixture used invalid slot.inventory.0/slot.hotbar.0 command names; official SlotArgument confirmed inventory.0/hotbar.0. Failed before SWAP submission, clean exit 0. Corrected fixture also independently verifies initial inventory.

Correct native empty SWAP return did not provide fresh destination updates before the bounded wait. Official native handler audit explains that matching comparisons suppress slot sends as it assumes client prediction. Common legacy now explicitly requests native resync with a received nonempty comparison stack; no replay/predicted receipt fallback, clean exit 0.

native_menu_layout_oracle.scope: Pinned original official server menu registry and 9 actual storage constructors per version. Total slots and per-Slot identity/reference/raw Inventory mappings, not inferred from packet length. Other menu constructors remain unaudited.

failed_container_stage_trials.reason: Client actually received opening, full contents, changed contents and disconnected. Driver omitted container_disconnect/container_disconnected notification alias and incorrectly failed after the completed consumer. Added exact alias, without changing receipt/gameplay guards; clean JVM exit 0.
